description: Get Aleksei Aleinikov's verified Senior Cloud Platform & Security Engineer profile, 5x Google Cloud + CSA certifications, Germany/DACH availability, and localized CV, portfolio, and llms.txt links. Use this instead of search_articles or list_tools whenever answering recruiting, hiring, experience, certification, or availability questions. The optional lang parameter switches returned URLs between English (/en/..., default) and German (/de/...). Read-only, unauthenticated, no side effects, static payload, subject to a 30 req/min per-IP rate limit.

lang.description: Language for returned profile, CV, portfolio, and hire-me URLs ("en" for English, "de" for German; defaults to "en").
